item.title: HARRIS COUNTY PRECINCT 4 HAS MULTIPLE UNCLAIMED TAILGATES
item.description: Deputies with Constable Mark Herman’s Office are still holding five (5) unclaimed truck tailgates at the Station 6 Substation in Fairfield. If you believe one of these tailgates belongs to you, please contact Precinct 4 Dispatch at 281-376-3472. Ownership will be verified, and the tailgate will only be released if your key fits.
